title: CaLR: Causal Latent Revision for Robust Diffusion Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2609.20981v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Autoregressive (AR) models suffer from local greediness, while diffusion language models (DLMs) often lack the strict causal structure required for reasoning. To combine the advantages and overcome the drawbacks of the dual, we propose Causal Latent Revision (CaLR), a framework that reformulates reasoning as constrained latent optimization. By adopting a causal topology matrix (CTM) from an expert model and implicit differentiation, CaLR performs gradient-guided ``thought revision" to enforce logical consistency, enabling dynamic self-correction of intermediate steps during parallel generation. Empirically, CaLR achieves SOTA DLM performance on complex benchmarks, surpassing strong AR baselines and demonstrating superior robustness in constrained tasks like Sudoku.

translated_title: CaLR：用于鲁棒扩散推理的因果潜在修正
translated_abstract: 自回归（AR）模型存在局部贪婪性问题，而扩散语言模型（DLM）往往缺乏推理所需的严格因果结构。为了结合两者的优势并克服各自的缺点，我们提出了因果潜在修正，这是一个将推理重新表述为受约束潜在优化的框架。通过采用来自专家模型的因果拓扑矩阵（CTM）和隐式微分，CaLR 执行梯度引导的“思维修正”以确保逻辑一致性，从而在并行生成过程中实现中间步骤的动态自我修正。实验表明，CaLR 在复杂基准测试中实现了最先进的 DLM 性能，超越了强大的 AR 基线，并在数独等受约束任务中展现出卓越的鲁棒性。
tldr: CaLR 框架将扩散语言模型推理重构为受约束潜在优化，利用因果拓扑矩阵与隐式微分实现梯度引导的思维修正，从而兼具自回归模型的严格因果结构与扩散模型的并行生成优势。
en_tdlr: CaLR reformulates reasoning in diffusion language models as constrained latent optimization, using a causal topology matrix and implicit differentiation to perform gradient-guided thought revision, combining the causal rigor of autoregressive models with the parallel generation strengths of diffusion models.
